questions.CQ1: What did a step call, with which arguments, and what came back or failed?
questions.CQ2: Which agent and step failed, how, and what did the failure reach?
questions.CQ3: Who passed which task to whom, and who is accountable for an output, back to the person who started the run?
questions.CQ4: Who routed work, to whom, among which candidates, and why?
questions.CQ5: Which memory records did a step read or write, who wrote them, and were they superseded?
questions.CQ6: Which checks and approvals stood between an output and its effect, with which outcome, by whom?
questions.CQ7: What did an output rely on: which model calls and tool calls produced what it depends on?
questions.CQ8: How many iterations did a loop run, which steps were retries, and what ended it?
questions.CQ10: In what order did the agents act, and which writes to shared memory conflicted?
questions.CQ11: How many tokens, how much cost, and how much time did each agent's model calls take?
questions.CQ12: Was content captured, and which models, settings, and inputs can replay the run?
